title: Mindscape Escape Rooms
specs: Private rooms for teams of 2 to 9 players
Minimum age 9 years; minors must be accompanied by an adult 18+ who fills out waiver
Rooms hold up to 9 adults comfortably; larger groups require contact

blurb: Guests solve puzzles and work together to escape themed rooms within 60 minutes. Rooms are private and designed for ages 9 and up, with minors requiring adult supervision. The experience includes all puzzle items and a game master guide.
